verdict.rationale: Asana's official MCP server explicitly supports having an AI assistant "generate reports and summaries based on Asana data" from the workspace. The API also documents reading status updates to build a status-update report. Pre-built AI agents and AI Teammates draw context from the Work Graph, but none of the evidence shows a native feature that drafts a project or initiative status update from recent activity, so the story relies on external AI clients or custom builds. Missing for 10: documented native AI status-update drafting, explicit coverage of recent-activity summarization into a status update object, independent or hands-on corroboration.
